results.reason_zh: 第 2 步寻找第二个可见的 /primer/design 链接。只读实测发现两个同址链接均存在，第二个文字链接尺寸正常；发布版却把第一个头像链接算成零宽，过滤后只剩一个可见候选，第二个可见候选因此不存在。PR 版第一个链接为 64×48。独立行内链接嵌套块元素实验也复现零宽到非零宽的差异。原始诊断另有选择器语法错误，已修复诊断采集，但它不是点击超时的原因。
results.reason_en: Step 2 requests the second visible /primer/design link. A read-only probe finds both links and normal text-link geometry, but the release gives the first avatar link zero width. Visibility filtering leaves only one candidate, so the second visible candidate does not exist. The PR build measures the first link as 64×48. An independent inline-link/block-content fixture reproduces the zero-to-nonzero width change. The original diagnostic selector error was separate and has been repaired; it did not cause the click timeout.

results.reason_zh: 第 2 步寻找第二个可见的 /byteblaze/gimmiethat.space 链接。只读实测确认第一个头像链接在发布版中宽度为零，在 PR 版中为 64×48；第二个文字链接在两版中均有正常尺寸。零宽候选被过滤后，原选择器要求的第二个可见链接不存在。这个差异与独立行内链接嵌套块元素实验一致。原始诊断的 SyntaxError 发生在点击超时之后，不是点击失败原因。
results.reason_en: Step 2 requests the second visible /byteblaze/gimmiethat.space link. The read-only probe measures the first avatar link at zero width in the release and 64×48 in the PR build; the second text link has normal geometry in both. Filtering out the zero-width candidate leaves no second visible link. This agrees with the independent inline-link/block-content fixture. The original diagnostic SyntaxError followed the click timeout and did not cause it.

cause_groups.label_zh: 按键与导航生命周期冲突
cause_groups.remediation_owner_zh: Moli 浏览器与 BrowserTool 集成
cause_groups.remediation_status_zh: 发布版失败保留；PR 修复版本轮通过
cause_groups.remediation_status_en: Released failure retained; PR build passed this cohort

results.reason_zh: Enter 的 Input.dispatchKeyEvent 返回 Navigation is changing the document，BrowserTool 将该次按键操作判为失败并终止轨迹。应区分导航已触发与协议调用完整成功，不能把这个错误描述成找不到按钮。 失败记录：第 3 步，动作 press。 源码：moli-protocol/src/domains/input.rs，start_pending_input_command。一次 Enter 包含 keydown 和 keyup。keydown 可以先启动换页，旧版随后用通用文档访问门禁拒绝同一次按键的 keyup，返回 Navigation is changing the document。修复允许导航期间的终止 keyup 发送给仍挂载的旧页面，其余按键仍受原门禁约束。
results.reason_en: Input.dispatchKeyEvent rejects Enter because navigation is changing the document. Recorded failure: step 3, action press. Source: moli-protocol/src/domains/input.rs, start_pending_input_command. An Enter press contains keydown and keyup. Keydown may initiate document replacement; the old general document-access gate then rejects the matching keyup with Navigation is changing the document. The fix delivers terminal keyup to the still-attached outgoing page while retaining the normal gate for other events.

results.reason_zh: 原始第 5 步把几何可见性、组件初始化、选项和事件绑定合并检查。补充只读实测逐项拆开后，组件已初始化、Color／Size 正确、向导关联与 Next 点击处理器均正常；发布版对话框和 Next 却返回零矩形，5 秒后仍不变，PR 版返回正常尺寸。失败条件是 getClientRects().length 为零，归入布局状态未更新。诊断额外等待 Edit Configurations 出现后才打开窗口，不点击 Next、不保存；原始成绩保留。
results.reason_en: The original step 5 combines geometry, component initialization, selected attributes and event binding. A supplemental read-only probe separates these checks: initialization, Color/Size selection, wizard ownership and the Next click handler are all ready, but the release returns zero rectangles for the dialog and Next button even after another five seconds; the PR build returns normal dimensions. The failed predicate is getClientRects().length > 0, locating stale layout geometry. This diagnostic additionally waits for Edit Configurations to appear before opening the dialog, never clicks Next or saves, and preserves the original score.

cause_groups.label_en: JSON document lacks expected text container
cause_groups.remediation_owner_zh: Moli 浏览器与 BrowserTool 集成
cause_groups.remediation_status_zh: 发布版失败保留；PR 修复版本轮通过

results.reason_zh: 贡献者 API 返回 HTTP 200 和有效 JSON 数组，但文档中没有文本提取动作要求的 pre 元素，读取等待 5 秒后失败。截图将 JSON 显示为普通换行文字，问题在文档呈现与提取接口的配合，不是服务器没有返回数据。 失败记录：第 6 步，动作 get_text。 目标：pre。 源码：moli-parser/src/session.rs，HtmlParserSession::initialize_text_document。旧版缺少 JSON/纯文本导航的专用文档构造路径。修复创建浏览器自有的 pre 外壳，再切换为纯文本 tokenizer，使返回内容保留为字面文本；JSON 默认 UTF-8，并关闭 HTML/XML 声明嗅探。对应发布版第 784 题的 pre 缺失和截图乱码。
results.reason_en: The contributors API returns valid JSON with HTTP 200; the rendered document lacks the pre element expected by the text extraction action. Recorded failure: step 6, action get_text. Target: pre. Source: moli-parser/src/session.rs, HtmlParserSession::initialize_text_document. The fix introduces a dedicated JSON/plain-text navigation document: create a browser-owned pre shell, then switch the tokenizer to plaintext so response bytes remain literal. JSON defaults to UTF-8 and bypasses HTML/XML declaration sniffing. This addresses the missing pre and mojibake observed in released task 784.
